llm_response.reason: The website features multiple scam indicators: it claims to sell luxury Golden Goose products with deep discounts and pervasive sale language, but lacks legitimate company information, address, contact phone number, or social media links. The site operates under an unrelated shop name (Stephanie Delinski) and provides only internal hyperlinks. There is ambiguity or absence around payment/verification details and corporate credentials, and all signs point to a mimicry operation exploiting a known brand for fraudulent purposes—matching many items on the scam detection list, especially those regarding fake online shops.
